description: Create real Thunderbird account nodes for EAS accounts, tag special folders, and store credentials in the password manager — all via XPCOM.

functions.name: createAccount
functions.description: Create (or re-use) a top-level Thunderbird account node with an identity for an EAS address. Idempotent.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The EAS server hostname; keeps accounts unique.

displayName.description: Name shown in the folder pane.

fullName.description: Display name used on outgoing mail.

functions.name: listAccounts
functions.description: List every Thunderbird account node this add-on could have created, so orphans left behind by a failed setup can be removed.

functions.name: setSpecialFolder
functions.description: Tag a folder as Inbox/Sent/Drafts/Trash/Outbox/Junk/Archives and point the identity at it.

parameters.name: folderPath
parameters.description: Folder path relative to the account root, e.g. '/Inbox'.

functions.name: setAccountName
functions.description: Rename the account node shown in the folder pane.

functions.name: removeAccount
functions.description: Remove an account node created by this add-on, including its local mail files.

functions.name: storePassword
functions.description: Store the EAS password in Thunderbird's password manager.

functions.name: getPassword
functions.description: Read the EAS password back from the password manager. Returns null if absent.
